# Set80 independent issue-recovery reference source

This is an **unexecuted** stdlib-only producer. The root agent alone authorizes and
runs it after peer review. It imports only the eight producer leaves beside
`generate.py`; copied inherited Python and Go declarations are documentary bytes.
No expected Set80 output exists at source freeze.

The exact approved contract is `f3e019a8...95610`, reference plan
`568251bd...c99d`, and committed predecessor is
`fdd40d8edd9a685613f1f667f0074e56ec4e7da5`. The public allowlist and every copied
file's source path/size/hash are recorded in `input-catalog.json`. These include
the unchanged Set79 corpus `a5c65673...25e3`, its complete source/qualification
bundle, and the original ManifestJob2 grammar corpus. No runtime fixture,
credential selection, wallet, seed, DB or network input is read.

Root's first execution failed before output: the selected Setup2 uses the later
names-v2 descriptor, absent from the older job-grammar corpus. The complete failed
source is preserved at `../reference-before-descriptor-selection`; root retained
`artifacts/set80/reference-attempt1`. This successor adds the committed independent
names-v2 descriptor corpus/provenance and verifies its exact canonical bytes,
existing descriptor preimage/domain and ID before extending the descriptor lookup.
It does not relabel an older tuple or change any selected Setup, old job/PoW anchor,
policy, deterministic recipe or case count. The earlier corpus remains the job
grammar and parity source. No successor producer execution is claimed here.

The second root execution also failed before output: balance/page anchors select
the inherited remote attachment's daily source, which was missing from the wire
extension's mining-family-only profile map. Its full predecessor is retained at
`../reference-before-money-profile-selection`. This successor includes the exact
already-derived remote profile and refuses every valid inherited envelope whose
source is absent from the complete selection map. Work/receipt profile placement,
the different page position, and error version/flag/status categories were checked
against all inherited input shapes. No inherited response body, source or monetary
value is rewritten; no case count or cap changes.

`recipe.json` contains authored deterministic input choices and hand-counted case
declarations. It selects three exact Setup2 fixtures and independently derives
new unmined ManifestJob2 jobs from their matching template/context/authority/key,
fixed challenge and time. Old jobs, nonce proofs and entry bodies remain separate
unchanged anchors. Lower transport/remote cases explicitly assume an opaque
selected SetupID; they are not misrepresented as matching full owners.

The producer covers new ordered objects/domain preimages, all 15 source/issuer
state pairs (seven legal), complete modeled new reverse namespaces, terminal and
duplicate recovery, required-null retained request rows, scan/cursor linkage,
conditional entry/count/byte accounting, raw JSON framing, inherited successful
routes with required new profile binding, and independent checked reservations.
Large whitespace cap boundaries are emitted as finite reconstruction recipes,
not multi-megabyte repeated hexadecimal strings.

Lifecycle events and entry lengths are **conditional requirements**, not proof of
atomic writes, entropy, cryptographic signatures, original session ownership,
mutex release, clean process joins or liveness. The financial sentinel is an
opaque equality obligation; this producer generates no transaction or new payout
math. Real original-owner fault controls and TLS/headless acceptance are later
qualification gates. Existing economic policies and all older bytes stay exact.

`producer-lock.proposed.json` inventories all source and public inputs and has
`execution_authorized:false`. Root creates a separately preserved approved lock
with that exact inventory and explicit true authorization. The generator checks
the complete tree, size/hash identities, catalog coverage, exact contract and
root authorization before importing its own leaves. Only `source-ready.json`,
the proposed lock, and an explicitly supplied root-level approved lock are
excluded from self-inventory; copied locks below `inputs/` are still bound.

Root invocation after approval:

```
python generate.py --lock /absolute/approved.json --output /fresh/external/output.json
```

Root runs two independently selected Python interpreters with the same lock,
120-second process/group bound, 1-MiB log bound and 16-MiB output bound, compares
complete outputs, and rechecks all inputs on success/failure. The script refuses
an existing output, uses exclusive/no-follow creation and fsync, retains partial
failures, and verifies input/lock identities again in `finally`. No output can
be written under the source root. Syntax-only AST review is permitted; importing
or invoking the producer before root admission is not.
